'''July 2000 Framingham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Framingham, MA on 8 July 2000. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d993">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-framingham-ma-7-8-2000d993/ framingham-ma-7-8-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 10 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-framingham-ma-7-8-2000d993/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Framingham, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
